title: Chargebacks and card disputes - support procedure
content: The demo agent asks for a non-sensitive description, relevant dates and steps already taken with the merchant. Actual eligibility, evidence and deadlines must come from the issuer's rules; the assistant does not provide legal advice or file a real dispute.
